./atoms-settings.purpose: Surface downloads reuse the Skill import review workflow, not the whole settings screen.

./plugin-catalog.purpose: Composer plugin chips consume the existing synthetic display catalog; this is not authoritative installed-plugin data.

./plugin-logo.purpose: Agent pickers and surface launchers share plugin logo presentation.

./plugin-operation-event-bridge.purpose: The shell mounts one plugin operation notification bridge.

./settings-dialog.purpose: The shell opens settings without depending on individual settings panes.

./translations.purpose: The single i18n composition loads these separately owned pure settings bundles.
